description.narrative: The Humanitarian Assistance Support Contract (HASC) assist with rapid response for Disaster Assistance Response Teams (DARTs) and help to support ongoing Response Management Teams (RMTs). Macfadden staff provide complex information management support services and comprehensive training support.
